title: How to evaluate unsupervised STDP: code, configurations and run maps
description:
Code, configurations and run-selection maps for the paper How to evaluate unsupervised STDP: separating the rule from the readout, the scaffold and the input (Abin S and Raji Susan Mathew).

The paper proposes an evaluation protocol for unsupervised plasticity rules: each trained network is compared with the same network with plasticity switched off, both are read by neuron labelling and by a linear probe, and both are compared with a linear probe on the input spikes. The protocol is applied to pair-STDP (Diehl and Cook), triplet-STDP (Pfister and Gerstner) and voltage-STDP (Clopath et al.) in competitive, fully connected spiking networks of 400 neurons on eight datasets (MNIST, N-MNIST, EMNIST-Letters, Fashion-MNIST and four MedMNIST sets), to an ablation of the competitive scaffold, to a two-layer convolutional network and to SoftHebb (Journé et al., 2023), a deep Hebbian method, on CIFAR-10 and four medical datasets. Controls for voltage-STDP include an exact reimplementation of Clopath's neuron and update rule.

Trained weights, run outputs and datasets are not included; README.md and RUN_MAP.md say how to regenerate each table and figure. SoftHebb's code and Clopath's MATLAB code are not redistributed; README.md says where to obtain them.
